## 1.3 High-Risk Warning Box
- **Dynamic SQL Injection Risk:** `cmdLog_Click` constructs inline SQL queries by concatenating user-controlled input from `dcUser.BoundText` (e.g., `getValueAt("SELECT ... WHERE PK=" & dcUser.BoundText, ...)`). This is a critical security risk.
- **Embedded ADO Operations:** The form contains two embedded, dynamic SQL statements that fetch user password and admin flag from the database directly from within the UI code.
- **Unmanaged External Dependencies:** The form relies on global functions `getValueAt()`, `changeYNValue()`, `Enc.DecryptString()`, and global object `CurrUser` from unknown modules; their absent source code constitutes a hidden coupling risk.

## 1.4 Executive Forensic Summary
1. **Business Mission:** Authenticate a user by selecting a username from a dropdown and entering a password. On success, store the authenticated user’s details (ID, admin flag) into a global session object (`CurrUser`) and close the login form.
2. **Interaction Style:** Modal, single-record authentication form with a data-bound combo and a password textbox. No master-detail or grid.
3. **Critical Dependencies:** Outbound calls to shared helper functions `getValueAt()`, `changeYNValue()`, and an encryption utility `Enc.DecryptString()`. Also references global variable `MAIN.CloseMe` to signal application shutdown.

features.title: User Authentication and Session Initialisation
features.description: Enables users to select their identity from a registered user list, enter their password, and authenticate against the system. Validates credentials, establishes a session on success, and provides a cancel option to terminate the application.

functions.label: Show available user accounts to choose from (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the login form opens, the system retrieves all user records and populates a dropdown list with their usernames. This enables the user to select their identity before entering a password.

functions.label: Verify password and start user session (cmdLog_Click)
functions.description: After the user selects a username and enters a password, the system checks that both fields are filled, retrieves the stored encrypted password, decrypts it, and compares it to the entered password (case-insensitive). If the credentials match, it creates a user session and closes the login form; otherwise, it displays an error message.

functions.label: Quit the application without logging in (cmdCancel_Click)
functions.description: When the user clicks Cancel, the system signals the main application to shut down and closes the login screen. This allows the user to abandon the authentication process and terminate the program entirely.

features.title: User Record Listing, Search, and CRUD Operations
features.description: Enables administrators to view all system user records in a list, search for specific entries, and perform create, edit, and delete operations, with grid refresh and session closure from the main form.
features.source: SRS UIBlueprint for frmuserrec, S.5 Events #1-#7 covering list population, search, add, edit, delete, refresh, and close.

functions.label: Display all user records upon opening (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the administrator opens the user management form, the system retrieves all user records from the database and displays them in the list. Icons are assigned to each entry from a shared image list for visual consistency. This provides an immediate overview of all users.

functions.label: Search user records with a text-based dialog (CommandPass 1)
functions.description: When the administrator triggers the search function and the user list is not empty, a modal find dialog opens for entering search text. The dialog filters the displayed user records based on the input. If the list is empty, an error notification appears to indicate that no records are available to search.

functions.label: Delete selected user record with protection checks (CommandPass 4)
functions.description: The administrator can delete a user record after passing the self-deletion prevention check (cannot delete own record) and a re-verification that the record still exists. A confirmation dialog is shown before the system permanently removes the record from the database and refreshes the list. Any referential integrity errors are caught and displayed as a user-friendly message.

functions.label: Open the new user form for data entry (CommandPass 2)
functions.description: The administrator initiates the creation of a new user by opening the add-user detail form in add mode. The form displays empty fields ready for input. Upon saving, the detail form triggers an automatic refresh of the user list to reflect the new record.

functions.label: Open the edit form for an existing user record (CommandPass 3)
functions.description: Before editing, the system verifies that a user row is selected and that the corresponding record still exists in the database. If both checks pass, the edit-user detail form opens in edit mode with the primary key of the selected item. This prevents editing records that have been removed or become stale.

functions.label: Refresh the displayed user records (CommandPass 5)
functions.description: The administrator can manually refresh the user list, which reloads all records from the database by re-querying the data store. This action is also triggered automatically after any successful add, edit, or delete operation to ensure the list stays up-to-date.

functions.label: Close the user management window (CommandPass 6)
functions.description: The administrator can close the user management form, which unloads the interface and clears its global instance. This provides standard window closure behaviour, allowing the administrator to exit the user listing view.

business_context.current_state: A VB6 form (frmuserrec) where an administrator can view all user records in a ListView (lvList), initiate a text-based search via a find dialog, and perform add, edit, and delete operations via command buttons. Delete includes self-deletion protection, existence re‑check, and confirmation dialog. Refresh and close capabilities are available.
business_context.target_state: A React user management page (<UserRecordManager />) backed by REST endpoints GET /api/v1/users, POST /api/v1/users, PUT /api/v1/users/{id}, and DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}, with a real-time search bar, inline editing, and optimistic UI updates.
